entities.summary: Robert Kyagulanyi Ssentamu, commonly known by his stage name Bobi Wine, is a Ugandan activist, politician, singer, lawyer, and actor. He leads the National Unity Platform (NUP), a political party in Uganda opposed to Yoweri Museveni's government.
